result.title: VoxSAOR: Semantic-Aware Occupancy Robustification via Aleatoric Uncertainty Modeling
result.comment: The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR
result.summary: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction provides a dense semantic representation of scenes for autonomous driving and embodied perception, yet remains vulnerable to occlusion, depth ambiguity, and projection errors that induce spatially varying reliability in voxel features. Existing methods typically map voxel representations to semantic predictions without explicitly modeling such observation-induced feature variations. To address this limitation, we propose VoxSAOR, a semantic-aware occupancy robustification framework that models aleatoric uncertainty through feature-space proxies. It first quantifies Local Semantic Consistency (LSC) to derive a voxel-wise structural stability prior and uses cross-view semantic consensus to filter unreliable semantic correspondences. Within each semantic category, spatially matched stable and ambiguous voxels form stable-to-ambiguous feature transitions, which are modeled by a class-conditional diagonal Gaussian distribution, capturing both feature displacement and dispersion. Guided by these proxy distributions, Aleatoric Regime Ensemble Learning (AREL) trains independently parameterized prediction heads using feature perturbations at progressively increasing scales, with perturbation strength modulated by structural reliability. At inference, proxy modeling and sampling are disabled, and all heads process the same observed features; their output probabilities are then averaged to produce a deterministic consensus prediction without requiring sampling. Experiments across multiple datasets and occupancy backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of VoxSAOR in improving semantic occupancy prediction, long-tail recognition, and predictive calibration. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VoxSAOR 框架，用特征空间代理建模 aleatoric uncertainty：先量化局部语义一致性得到体素级结构稳定性先验，并用跨视图语义共识过滤不可靠对应，再以类条件对角高斯刻画由稳定到模糊体素的特征位移与离散度，据此用递增尺度的特征扰动训练多个预测头，推理时关闭采样并平均各头概率。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文面向纯 3D occupancy 预测、无推理期 latent 状态生成，主线联系间接；其跨视图共识过滤与不确定性代理分布可供核查是否能作为视觉证据筛选与可靠 latent 表示加权的线索。
